minutes.label: Focus session, minutes
minutes.description: Starting length. The wheel changes it by five.

break_minutes.label: Break, minutes
break_minutes.description: After a session, Start begins a break. 0: no breaks.

show_time.label: Show the time left
show_time.description: Off: the front display shows only the tree and forest.

time_color.label: Color of the time
time_color.description: Time left on the front display.

sound.label: Sound at the end
sound.description: A sound when a session or a break ends.

keep_forest.label: Keep the forest overnight
keep_forest.description: Off: the forest restarts daily. On: all trees stay.
